data.description: 【喜多川海梦 · 居家睡衣趴】周末温馨的卧室大床上，换上宽松丝绸睡衣的海梦整个人趴在松软的抱枕堆里，一边摇晃着修长的大腿一边对着手机上的动漫番剧兴奋傻笑——「今天我要在床上躺平一整天！薯片和快乐水都准备好了，快过来和我一起看最新一集！」
data.promptProse: Marin lies face-down on the bed in loose pastel silk pajamas, hugging a plush toy while laughing at anime on the phone placed nearby. Button-up top and matching pajama trousers remain comfortably closed. The medium view includes pillows around her and anime posters beyond the bed. Warm bedside-lamp light catches the silk folds and toy fur, with cozy fairy lights softly marking the room's depth and shaded bedding beneath her arms.
data.title: 喜多川海梦 · 居家睡衣趴
